title: Human field ground truth
description: One file per document, placed in ocr-benchmark/labels/fields/<docId>.json. Not produced this pass; the schema exists so labels drop in without reshaping the scorer.

checkedBy.description: Independent second reader; required for critical fields

resolvedBy.description: Lawyer who resolved a genuine ambiguity

verbatimValue.description: Exactly as it appears on the page, including punctuation and leading zeros. Scored by the OCR benchmark.

normalizedValue.description: Canonical form. Scored by the extraction benchmark.

bbox.description: [x0,y0,x1,y1] normalized, origin top-left, in the ORIGINAL render frame

ambiguous.description: The document itself cannot be read with confidence. Excluded from accuracy denominators and reported separately. Never invent a value to avoid this flag.
